# Knivesandtools

> > Your comprehensive UK destination for premium kitchen knives, pocket knives, outdoor tools, tactical gear and knife maintenance equipment from world-renowned brands.

Knivesandtools is a specialized retailer offering an extensive catalog of knives, multitools, torches, binoculars and outdoor equipment from premium international brands. The site features product reviews, sharpening guides and a curated selection of tested, in-stock items for both professional and recreational use.

## Key Topics

- Pocket knives
- Kitchen knives
- Fixed-blade knives
- Survival knives
- Multitools
- Knife sharpening
- LED torches
- Bushcraft
- Tactical gear
- Chef knives
- Victorinox
- Spyderco
- Leatherman
- Outdoor gear
- Knife brands

## Featured Brands & Collections

- [Spyderco knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/spyderco-knives.htm): Spyderco pocket knives including Paramilitary 2, Delica 4 and Tenacious models
- [Victorinox knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/victorinox-swiss-army-knife.htm): Victorinox Swiss Army knives, pocket knives, multitools and kitchen knives
- [Gerber Strongarm knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/gerber-strongarm.htm): Gerber Strongarm fixed blade knife product catalog with 420HC and CPM Magnacut steel options
- [Leatherman multitools](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/leatherman-tools.htm): Leatherman multitools catalog featuring Wave+, Charge TTI+ and Wingman models
- [ESEE Knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/esee-knives-survival-knives.htm): ESEE Knives survival and tactical fixed knives including Model 4 bushcraft options
- [Fällkniven knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/fallkniven.htm): Fällkniven Swedish survival and outdoor knives including F1 and S1 models
- [Buck Knives](https://www.knivesandtools.co.uk/en/ct/buck-knives.htm): Buck Knives pocket and fixed blade hunting and survival knives catalog
